title: 从人类基因组到人类脑细胞图谱
originalTitle: From the human genome to the human brain cell atlas
summary: BRAIN Initiative Cell Atlas Network (BICAN) 正在建立一个跨物种的脑细胞图谱，整合细胞身份、解剖结构和多模态证据，类比于人类基因组计划，BICAN 基底神经节图谱是推进脑组织、功能、变异和疾病理解的联邦参考模型。

story.title: BRAIN Initiative发布首个跨物种基底节细胞图谱及全脑扩展计划

author: Joseph Ecker, Satrajit Ghosh, Michael Hawrylycz, Kiku Ichihara, Arnold Kriegstein, Ed Lein, Chongyuan Luo, Evan Macosko, Shoaib Mufti, Bing Ren, Carol Thompson, Tim Tickle, Andreas Tolias, David Van Essen, Owen White, Xiangmin Xu, Hongkui Zeng, Guo-Qiang Zhang
